jordan: Opal Analytics (acct 5587) replied to our overdue notice for INV-2026-045. they say a $1,150 vendor pass-through (connector licensing) was charged in error and asked us to pause collections while they verify. attached a short screenshot.

maya: can you paste the disputed invoice line here? i'll pull the ledger entry.

```
INV-2026-045
```

collections-bot: automated: dunning reminder sent to billing@opal.ai on 2026-05-16 14:02 UTC (INV-2026-045).

kevin: ledger shows vendor_charge vndr_511 on 2026-05-03 triggered when connector was enabled by an account admin. opal says procurement never approved org-wide.

maya: policy: charges < $2k can be approved by collections for one-off credits after quick review. ask Opal for the admin audit log within 5 business days; pause collections and waive late fees while they investigate.

jordan: reply drafted: we'll pause dunning, waive late fees during the review window, and request the admin audit log for connector enablement. if no authorization is shown after 7 days we'll offer a one-time goodwill credit for the vendor line and propose a 30-day split for the remaining balance. cc'ing AM and legal.

collections-bot: automated: collections workflow paused for INV-2026-045 by collections (maya) at 2026-05-16 15:10 UTC.

kevin: created ticket ZD-4722 and attached the ledger entry and connector enable logs. flagged legal and sales. created ENG-9250 to add clearer connector enable audit fields in admin UI (requested by legal).

jordan: noted follow-up: calendar reminder on 2026-05-23 to check ZD-4722. if Opal confirms authorization, resume collections; if not, issue credit memo CM-2026-039 for $1,150 and regenerate invoice INV-2026-045-R1.

maya: approved on discretion. log reason = disputed vendor pass-through; credit cap under $2k. don't issue final credit until 7-day window closes.

jordan: sending reply now. will update thread when Opal responds. :white_check_mark:
